newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Two Swedes expelled from Russia as spies - agency.
newsitem.headline: Two Swedes expelled from Russia as spies - agency.

text.p: Two Swedes, one of them a diplomat, have been expelled from Russia for alleged spying, the Swedish news agency TT reported on Wednesday.
TT quoted Russian media as saying the man was alleged to have been spying in St. Petersburg. A Swedish diplomat had also been expelled, the agency added.
A Swedish foreign ministry spokesman said he was unaware of the case.
TT reported that the Swedish man had been arrested in February and had confessed to spying. He and the diplomat had already left Russsia, the agency added.
No other details were immediately available.
